en.headline: High Court sentences Joshua Wong to 10 years for foreign collusion
en.dek: The 30-year-old activist, already serving a term for subversion, received the concurrent sentence after pleading guilty to conspiring with Nathan Law and others to lobby for sanctions.
body: The High Court on Thursday sentenced Joshua Wong Chi-fung to 10 years in prison for conspiring to collude with foreign forces under the National Security Law.

Wong, 30, had pleaded guilty to the charge in September. The court found he had conspired with former lawmaker Nathan Law and others to urge foreign governments to impose sanctions or other measures against Hong Kong and mainland China in the period after the law took effect in June 2020.

He is already serving a four-year-and-eight-month sentence imposed in November 2024 for conspiracy to commit subversion related to an unofficial primary election. That term was due to end in January 2027. The new sentence will run concurrently.
Judge William Tam described the offences as grave in nature. Wong has been in custody since late 2020.

zh.headline: 高等法院判黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力罪名成立 判監10年
zh.dek: 30歲的黃之鋒早前承認控罪，新刑期與現正服刑的顛覆罪刑期同期執行，他原定明年1月刑滿。
body: 高等法院周四就黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力一案判刑，判處他監禁10年。
黃之鋒現年30歲，今年9月已承認控罪。法庭指他與流亡前立法會議員羅冠聰等人串謀，在國家安全法於2020年6月30日實施後，游說外國政府對香港及內地實施制裁或其他敵對措施。
他目前正服刑，因參與非正式初選而於2024年11月被判串謀顛覆罪名成立，判監4年8個月，原定2027年1月刑滿。新判的10年刑期將同期執行。
法官譚國強形容案情嚴重。黃之鋒自2020年底以來一直被羈押。
